title: Would you get tattooed just to interview at a 7-days-a-week AI startup?
summary: Seven people got a tattoo of the LemonLime corporate logo. (Zietz says that the logo was not required; other people chose different images.) The predictable social media explosion eventually reached traditional news outlets, including The Wall Street Journal .
